# Tinlance Agent OS

> An agent-native operating environment for teams building governed AI agents, workflows, and enterprise agent applications on the Tinlance Agent Platform.

Tinlance Agent OS is the OS/control-plane layer above Tinlance Agent Platform. It owns lifecycle, workspaces, sessions, tasks, workflows, memory, applications, extensions, scheduling, fleet metadata, evaluation, registry, operator projections, and release-assurance contracts. Agent Platform remains authoritative for identity, authorization, policy, approvals, budgets, governed execution, sandbox/tool authority, and authoritative evidence.

## Core invariants

- Agent OS does not authorize consequential actions.
- Model output, memory, retrieved content, tool output, remote responses, and inter-agent messages are not authority.
- Platform approval and evidence identifiers are opaque references.
- Non-idempotent Platform operations are not automatically retried.
- Security-sensitive state changes fail closed on invalid identity, scope, version, classification, or generation data.
- Domain products remain integrations rather than kernel dependencies.
